proposed_bindings.expanded_columns: 12 numeric values in the stated order, followed by 12 missing-value flags in the same order
proposed_bindings.metadata_policy: Only strict feature-v0 measurement objects are accepted; hashes, paths, format/debug strings and source labels are not feature columns. Source IDs affect training weights only.
proposed_bindings.weights: Equal weight per independent source component, half within each class, equal cases within each component/class; both classes required per training component
proposed_bindings.imputation: Training-weighted observed mean per column, zero for all-missing training columns; held-out observations never change these values
proposed_bindings.standardization: Training-weighted population mean and standard deviation after imputation and flag expansion; constant scale set to one. Anchor-centered summation preserves exact constants. All-missing numeric columns stay zero on held-out data.
proposed_bindings.objective: Source/class-weighted mean binary cross entropy + 0.5 * 1.0 * squared L2 norm of all 24 coefficients; intercept unpenalized
proposed_bindings.solver: Deterministic float64 damped Newton, zero initialization, direct Hessian solve
proposed_bindings.failure_policy: Non-finite values, singular solve, failed line search or nonconvergence stop without a partial model or alternate solver
